==Example Question==
Larry’s father has four sons. Their names are listed below. What is the name of his fourth son?

Rick, Nick, Mick and '''Larry''' 

The question says Larry’s father. So the fourth son is, of course, Larry.

== 30% ==
Have a look at these two words:

polish reading

'''P'''olish '''R'''eading

Without adding or taking away any letters, what simple written change will make these words sound different and have a different meaning?

If you change the first letter of each word to a capital letter it changes their meaning and pronunciation, so reading becomes Reading and polish becomes Polish

[[File:Clock 2.png|frameless]]

'''12:50''': The hour hand would point towards the 1, and the minute hand would point towards 10, meaning it becomes 10 to 1.
